steps.comment: OPTIONAL: client certificates (mTLS) on the Gateway - certificate Mandatory, two client CA chains trusted, CRL check Mandatory on each issuing CA
steps.note: EXAMPLE policy only, to show the automation - adapt CAs, CRL URLs, Mandatory/Optional and the authentication flow to your own design. Run after 01-certs-client-ca.json and 04-gateway.json (05 optional). Every client then needs a certificate from one of the bound CAs; a revoked one (or an expired / unreachable CRL) is refused.

steps.comment: CRLs: created from the uploaded first copy, then switched to HTTP refresh
steps.note: 14.1 does not build the first copy from the URL (Status Undefined) - see docs/troubleshooting.md. The crlpath is a file name in the default CRL directory /var/netscaler/ssl (01-certs-client-ca.json uploads it there); a path outside it is refused with 1650.

steps.comment: SSL profile for the Gateway: like ssl_prof_frontend_secure plus client authentication
steps.note: A separate profile: ssl_prof_frontend_secure is also used by the callback vserver (06), which must not ask for a client certificate. clientauthuseboundcachain: only the CA chains bound to the vserver are accepted.
MANUAL in the journal. Before an undo of this file: set ssl vserver gw_example_com -sslProfile ssl_prof_frontend_secure (a profile in use cannot be removed).

steps.comment: Trusted client CA chains: root (OCSP optional) + issuing (CRL Mandatory) per CA
